title: Comparing Prompted vs Fine-Tuned Monitors on MALT: Does In-Context Learning Saturate Monitor Quality?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Determines whether organizations should invest in monitor training infrastructure or rely on prompt engineering. Direct cost and capability implication for monitoring systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: LoRA fine-tuning on 7B model is documented and feasible on single GPU. However, preparing training data, tuning hyperparameters, and comparing calibration requires more than beginner skills. Medium compute sufficient.
